identity.title: Time-reproduction (Time2Dist) — Exp2
identity.summary: Multi-session time-reproduction paradigm with a *pre-generated per-subject schedule*. A make_schedule_Exp2.m script is run once at recruitment to produce trial_schedule.mat — which fixes the stimulus list, distribution-to-day mapping, and RNG state for every block. The main script loads that file at block start and replays it deterministically; no per-trial randomization in the run-time loop. Day 1 is uniform-prior training; Days 2-5 carry the within-subject counterbalanced stimulus distribution (each subject sees 2 days of dist A and 2 days of dist B; the day-to-dist assignment varies between subjects). ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE — exact n_blocks/n_trials/total_trials are placeholders; the live spec is produced by running /experiment-anatomy:analyze against the source.
identity.research_question: Whether within-subject exposure to different prior distributions (A vs. B) systematically reshapes temporal reproduction across days.

hierarchy.one_liner: session: par.day 1..5 (within_subject); block: for iR=1:nBlocks (Day1 training vs Day2-5 test counts read from par.schedule); trial: for iT=1:nT (read from par.schedule.Stm{iR}); pre-generated schedule replayed deterministically — see open_questions for exact counts.

phases.label: uniform-prior training
phases.description: Training phase with uniform-prior stimuli (dist=U). Block/trial counts read from the schedule — placeholder here pending live /analyze.

phases.label: test (within-subject counterbalanced dist A/B)
phases.description: Test phase; dist on each day determined by the per-subject schedule (2 A-days + 2 B-days across Days 2-5). Block/trial counts read from the schedule.

factors.name: dist
factors.description: Stimulus distribution. U = uniform (Day 1 training only). A and B are the test distributions; each subject experiences 2 days of A and 2 days of B during Days 2-5. Day-to-dist mapping is generated per subject in make_schedule_Exp2.m and stored in trial_schedule.mat.
evidence: Exp2/sub/Seed_Duration.m: par.schedule.dist read at block start

factors.name: day
factors.description: Session day. Day 1 = uniform-prior training, Days 2-5 = test with counterbalanced dist.
evidence: Exp2/main_duration.m: par.day driven by session loop

factors.name: stim_duration
factors.description: Per-trial target duration. NOT sampled at run time — read from par.schedule.Stm{iR}(iT), where the schedule was generated once per subject by make_schedule_Exp2.m and saved to trial_schedule.mat. The empirical distribution per day depends on `dist`.

conditions.label: test-A
conditions.description: Test condition with distribution A. Realized on 2 of Days 2-5 per subject — specific days assigned by the per-subject counterbalance in make_schedule_Exp2.m.

conditions.label: test-B
conditions.description: Test condition with distribution B. Realized on the other 2 of Days 2-5 per subject (counterbalanced with test-A).

design_matrix_summary: Within-subject counterbalance of dist across Days 2-5: each subject experiences 2 A-days + 2 B-days. The day-to-dist mapping per subject (e.g., subjNum mod 4 → A-B-B-A / A-B-A-B / B-A-A-B / B-A-B-A across Days 2-5) is generated once at recruitment by make_schedule_Exp2.m and frozen into trial_schedule.mat. The run-time main script never decides dist — it reads par.schedule.dist[par.day].

parameters.name: schedule_file
parameters.description: Per-subject pre-generated schedule loaded at session start. Contains par.schedule (Stm, Stm_pr, dist-per-day, etc.) and par.scheduleRngState. Generated once at recruitment by make_schedule_Exp2.m.

parameters.name: tprecue
parameters.description: Pre-cue interval before the moving stimulus appears.

saved_variables.name: Stm
saved_variables.description: Target stimulus duration for the trial. Source: par.schedule.Stm{iR}(iT) — pre-generated, not sampled at run time.

saved_variables.name: schedule
saved_variables.description: The full pre-generated per-subject schedule (stimulus list per block × trial, dist per day, feedback masks). Read at block start; written into the per-session results.mat for self-contained replay.

saved_variables.name: scheduleRngState
saved_variables.description: RNG state captured at schedule generation time. Enables exact reconstruction of the per-subject schedule from make_schedule_Exp2.m.

figure_outputs.what: Per-day scatter of reproduction vs. target duration with regression line.

data_paths.format_hint: MATLAB .mat with par.results struct (per-trial Stm/Est/Confidence + finalState meta)
par.schedule + par.scheduleRngState — the pre-generated counterbalance per subject

storage.naming_convention: <subID>_day<N>.mat for session logs; results_<subID>_day<N>_block<iR>.mat for per-block backups; <subID>/trial_schedule.mat for the per-subject schedule.

seed.source: saved RNG state in trial_schedule.mat (par.scheduleRngState) — captured during make_schedule_Exp2.m at recruitment

randomization.description: Per-subject schedule pre-generated once at recruitment by make_schedule_Exp2.m with a captured RNG state; replayed deterministically each session by loading trial_schedule.mat at block start. No per-trial sampling in the run-time script. A stranger with trial_schedule.mat can reproduce the exact stimulus sequence.

score.notes: Pre-generated schedule + saved RNG state earn full seed/randomization credit (gold-standard reproducibility). Lost on environment capture only — no requirements/setup file documents PTB version explicitly.

counterbalancing.scheme: Within-subject counterbalance of dist across Days 2-5 (2 A-days + 2 B-days per subject); day-to-dist mapping generated once per subject in make_schedule_Exp2.m and saved into trial_schedule.mat.
